hero.heading: Building peace and resilience across rural Sudan.
hero.subhead: We partner with local leaders to advance education, water access, and community-led peacebuilding — from Darfur and Kordofan to the Blue Nile.
hero.imageAlt: The pyramids of Meroë rising from the desert in Northern Sudan

home.missionBody1: The Sudanese Rural Community (SRC) works alongside community advisory boards in fifteen states to deliver education, water, health, and peacebuilding programs designed by Sudanese communities themselves.
home.missionBody2: Our methodology is grounded in three principles: local ownership of every project, transparent reporting to donors and beneficiaries, and durable partnerships with traditional leaders, women's cooperatives, and youth councils.
home.quote: Dignity is the foundation of peace. We don't deliver aid — we partner with rural communities to build the tools they need for their own prosperity.
home.reportBody: A complete breakdown of programs, finances, and impact across all fifteen states where SRC operates.
home.ctaBody: Your support funds clean water, classrooms, and community-led peace councils where they're needed most.

about.eyebrow: Founded 2015 · Headquartered in Paris · Operating in North Sudan
about.heading: A decade of resilience and rural reform.
about.intro: Founded by the Sudanese diaspora in Paris and rooted in North Sudan's rural heartlands, SRC delivers education, water, health, and peacebuilding programs in partnership with local communities — and represents their voices at United Nations forums in Geneva and beyond.
about.storyImageAlt: A community health worker sorting medications at an SRC mobile clinic in rural Sudan
about.storyP1: SRC was founded on a simple premise: those closest to the challenges of rural life are best equipped to design the solutions. In Sudan, rural areas face multi-layered crises — from climate-induced water scarcity to fragmented peace.
about.storyP2: Our approach is holistic. We don't just build schools; we build community centers that serve as hubs for peace mediation. We don't just provide water; we empower local committees to manage and maintain their own natural resources.
about.storyP3: Today, SRC works with international partners to bridge global humanitarian standards with local cultural context — and we publish every program budget so the communities we serve can hold us accountable.
about.value1Desc: Resources directed to the most isolated rural sectors, where impact is highest per dollar.
about.value2Desc: Every program is designed and approved by community advisory boards before launch.
about.value3Desc: Quarterly financial reporting and open-access program data for all donors.
about.value4Desc: Sudanese problems are solved by Sudanese teams, supported by global standards.
about.intlHeading: From rural Sudan to the United Nations in Geneva.
about.intlP1: Operating from our Paris headquarters, SRC carries the priorities of rural Sudanese communities into international policy spaces. We attend the UN Human Rights Council and humanitarian coordination meetings in Geneva, working alongside member states and partner NGOs to advocate for sustained funding, civilian protection, and dignified humanitarian access.
about.intlP2: Our delegation regularly participates in UNHCR pledging conferences, OCHA humanitarian roundtables, and side events at the UN General Assembly — bringing field-verified data and the testimony of community advisors directly into the rooms where policy is shaped.
about.leadIntro: Elected officers and senior staff guide the organization's mission, finances, and field operations.

impact.heading: Our impact, audited and reported.
impact.intro: Every figure on this page is verified by an independent auditor and published in our annual report. Numbers reflect cumulative results from 2015 through the latest reporting period.
impact.stat1Desc: Families across 15 states supported with education and social services.
impact.stat2Desc: Solar-powered boreholes serving drought-prone rural districts.
impact.stat3Desc: Learning spaces renovated, equipped, and staffed with trained teachers.
impact.stat4Desc: Local mediation boards established to prevent and resolve communal conflicts.
impact.story1Quote: Before the borehole, my children walked four hours each day for water. Now they are at the learning center, and I have a garden.
impact.story2Quote: The digital library in our village was something we only saw on television. SRC brought the world to our fingertips.
impact.mapBody: From North Kordofan to the Blue Nile and the highlands around Port Sudan, our reach is guided by local advisory boards and global humanitarian standards.
impact.ctaBody: Every donation funds a project that's tracked, reported, and audited.

legal.prevails: In case of any discrepancy between language versions, the English text prevails.
legal.privacyIntro: The Sudanese Rural Community (SRC) respects your privacy. This page explains what personal data we collect through this website and how we use it.
legal.privacyCollectB: When you contact us or subscribe to our newsletter we collect the details you provide (such as your name and email address) together with a one-way hashed record of your IP address for security and abuse prevention. We do not sell your data or share it with third parties for marketing.
legal.privacyUseB: We use your contact details only to respond to your message or, for newsletter subscribers who have confirmed by email (double opt-in), to send our quarterly impact report. You can unsubscribe at any time using the link in every email.
legal.privacyPayB: Donations are processed by Stripe. SRC never receives or stores your full card details.
legal.privacyRetB: We keep submissions only as long as needed to respond and meet our record-keeping obligations. You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data by contacting us.
legal.privacyNote: This is a template policy — SRC should review and adapt it with legal counsel before launch.

legal.termsUseB: You agree not to misuse the site, attempt to disrupt it, or submit unlawful content through our forms.
